verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of an API versioning scheme or a deprecation policy. API reference URLs contain a "v1" path segment (for example the Directory API users/list page), but no evidence text describes versioning guarantees, deprecation timelines, sunset notices or migration windows. Path naming alone is not a documented deprecation policy, so the story's core element is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
